privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: CoinVitrine is a non-commercial hobby project. This page explains which personal data it processes and why, who can see it and what your rights are. The EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.p1: Responsible for your data (the controller) is {{name}}. Contact: {{email}}.

data.title: What data we process
data.i1: Account details: your first and last name, username, email address, date of birth and password. The password is only stored as a one-way hash.
data.i2: Preferences and times: your language, theme and color choices; when you signed up, signed in and last used the site.
data.i3: Your content: collections, coin details and the photos you upload. All extra information in photos (EXIF), including the location, is removed on upload.
data.i4: Technical records: the server logs the address, time and result of each request and keeps them for 30 days. Search terms in the address, the user filter of Explore and the keys of share links are not written to the log. Your IP address is only recorded when a request limit is exceeded. The hosting provider also writes the IP address, time, address, result and browser details of each request to its own server logs and keeps them for 6 months.
data.i5: Emails: the emails you send us and your email address.

purposes.title: Why we process it (legal basis)
purposes.i1: To provide your account and collection: account and content data (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, performance of a contract). Your date of birth is only used to check the minimum age of 18.
purposes.i2: To keep the site safe: technical records, request limits, the temporary lock after failed sign-ins and moderation against abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, legitimate interest).
purposes.i3: To run the site, as totals: for example the number of accounts that used the site in the last 30 days. These numbers are not used to assess individuals (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, legitimate interest).
purposes.i4: To answer the emails you send us: your email address and message (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, legitimate interest).
purposes.p1: Your data is not sold, not used for advertising or profiling, and not processed for any other purpose.

visibility.title: Who can see it
visibility.p1: Collections are private by default; only you can see them. If you share a collection publicly or with a link, that collection, its coins and photos are visible together with your username. Your name, email address and date of birth are never shown to others.
visibility.p2: For moderation, the site's administrators can see your username, email address, first and last name, when you signed up, last signed in and last used the site, whether your account is locked, the number of your collections, coins and photos, the storage you use, and the content you share (including the link of collections you share by link); they cannot see your private collections. Administrators' actions (locking, hiding, deleting) are recorded in an audit log with their time and the reason the administrator wrote.

cookies.title: Cookies and browser storage
cookies.p1: The site only uses the cookies it needs to work, so it does not ask for consent:
cookies.i1: coinportal.auth keeps you signed in. After signing up and with "Remember me" it lasts 14 days and is extended while you use the site; without "Remember me" it ends when you close the browser. Signing out removes it at once.
cookies.i2: coinportal.af and XSRF-TOKEN stop forms from being sent from other sites (security).
cookies.p2: Your language, theme and color choices are kept in the browser's local storage. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, and pages load nothing (fonts, scripts) from other sites.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.p1: The site runs on servers of MonsterASP.NET s.r.o. (Prague, Czech Republic) in data centers in the European Union; the data and the emails sent to our contact address are stored there. The provider processes the data only on our behalf and on our instructions (a data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR). Your data is not shared with anyone else.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.p1: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, your account, collections, coins and photos are deleted at once. Entries in the administrators' audit log (action, time, reason) remain, but your name is removed from them; a reason an administrator wrote stays as written. Technical records are deleted after 30 days. The hosting provider backs up the site's files, the database and the mailboxes every day and keeps the backups for 21 days, so deleted data remains in them for up to 21 days. The provider's server logs are deleted after 6 months. Emails you send us are kept as long as needed to answer your request and then deleted.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability. You can download all your data as a ZIP file (including the administrators' records about your account and collections) and delete your account yourself in Settings > Account. To correct your name, email address or date of birth, and for anything else, write to the email address above.
rights.p2: If you think your data is processed unlawfully, you can complain to a data protection supervisory authority.

age.title: Minimum age
age.p1: Only people aged 18 or over can sign up for CoinVitrine.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: If this policy changes, the current version is published on this page with its new date.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms set out the rules for using CoinVitrine. By signing up you accept them. How your personal data is processed is explained in the privacy policy.

service.title: The service
service.p1: CoinVitrine is a free, non-commercial hobby site for recording, photographing and, if you like, sharing your euro coin collection. The site is provided as is: there is no guarantee that it runs without interruption or that data is never lost. For data that matters to you, use the export in Settings > Account.

account.title: Your account
account.p1: To sign up you must be at least 18 and give correct information. An account is personal; do not share your password. Creating accounts automatically or in bulk is not allowed.

content.title: Your content
content.p1: Your collections, coin details and photos remain yours. When you share a collection, you allow the site to show it with its photos for as long as you share it. Only upload photos you took yourself or have the right to use.

rules.title: What is not allowed
rules.p1: The following is not allowed in what you share and on the site:
rules.i1: illegal content, and photos or texts that infringe other people's copyright
rules.i3: insults, hate speech, violence or sexual content
rules.i4: advertising, spam and content unrelated to coins
rules.i5: overloading the site, trying to get around its security, or collecting data from it automatically in bulk

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.p1: Administrators can hide a collection shared against these rules: it becomes private and cannot be shared again until the lock is lifted. For serious or repeated violations they can lock the account (no sign-in, shared collections not visible) or delete it. Every action is recorded with its time and reason; you can see the records about you in your data export.

objection.title: Objections
objection.p1: To object to a decision, write to the email address on the contact page; your objection will be reviewed and you will be told the outcome.

ending.title: Ending your account
ending.p1: You can delete your account at any time in Settings > Account; all your data is deleted at once. If the site is to close, this will be announced on the site as early as possible, with time to download your data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: If these terms change, the current version is published on this page with its new date.
